Loss for the closed year of account (0.9) GBP m.
During 2022, the following amounts are proposed to be collected from members. 2019 Year of Account 0.9 GBP m.

named_events.loss_description: certain underwriting exposures in the region, do not believe there will be a material financial impact to Syndicate 6117

data.standardized_narrative: The 2019 Year of Account, which closed in 2021 via reinsurance to close, resulted in a net loss of GBP 0.9 million. This loss is proposed to be collected from members, indicating an adverse development or strengthening for that prior year of account. The claims development triangle shows no movement for prior years due to the transfer of liabilities via the RITC process.
raw_causal_phrases: Loss for the closed year of account
amounts are proposed to be collected from members
The RITC process means that Insurance, Financial, Credit, Liquidity, Market and Capital risks are transferred to the accepting Syndicate.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is based on the net loss for the 2019 closed year of account, which was reinsured to close. The claims development triangle shows zero movement for prior years due to the RITC transfer of liabilities.
